The ASSR stage vocabulary, and it is ALREADY pinned rather than merely duplicated: backend/tests/assrStageLabelOneHome.test.ts is titled "the ASSR stage vocabulary has exactly one home" and scans the source for exactly these sites. That is the second remedy this gate offers. The five files consume the vocabulary; they do not each decide it.

A shared MIRROR pair, which is this repo's established way of giving one rule to both runtimes: backend/src/scm/shared/* and frontend/src/vendor/scm/lib/* are held byte-identical by check-shared-mirrors --strict, a gate that already runs in backend-typecheck. Two copies that CANNOT diverge are not two answers.

One home, plus its TYPE. autocount-convert-lines.ts holds the value; autocount-outbox.ts imports from it (line 115) and only restates the key set as a TypeScript union in annotations. A union that drifted from the imported record would fail to compile where the two meet, so the compiler is the referee here.

Same pair, same reason: DOWNSTREAM and CONVERT_TARGET are declared once in autocount-convert-lines.ts and imported by autocount-outbox.ts, which restates 'DO' | 'GR' | 'IV' | 'PI' only as a type annotation on its own signatures.

The one member that differs is VOIDED, and its absence from the shorter set is the POINT, not an oversight. The shorter set is the salesperson STEPPER; a terminal void state is not a step. assr-stage-labels.ts records the failure that came from getting this backwards: portal.ts built the stepper by mapping ALL_STAGES, which DOES carry voided, so the word appeared on every case rather than only voided ones.

TWO DEFERRED-ENRICHMENT CONTRACTS that happen to name the same four columns, each ALREADY reduced to one home per document family and each with a REFEREE. The PO/GRN lists pin LIST_MRP_ENRICHMENT_KEYS against the frontend's LIST_MRP_DERIVED_FIELDS (backend/tests/listMrpEnrichmentKeys.test.ts); the PI list pins PI_LIST_MRP_ENRICHMENT_KEYS against PI_MRP_DERIVED_LIST_FIELDS (piListEnrichment.test.ts). Each pair fails CI naming the drifting key. Collapsing the two families onto one list would ASSERT that the PI list must always heal exactly what the PO and GRN lists heal — a stronger claim than either module makes, since a document family is entitled to its own enrichment shape. Two homes, two referees, both watching.

A VENDORED TWIN, not a second decision: the sofa seatHeight ALIAS list in backend/src/scm/shared/so-variant-rule.ts and its copy under frontend/src/vendor/shared/ so the browser runs the same rule. Same file pair and same referee as the DIVANLESS_AXES entry — check-shared-mirrors.mjs compares the two function-by-function and fails on DIVERGED.

NOT SETTLED — RAISED FOR THE OWNER, recorded as open rather than decided. The consignment order's identity lock still FREEZES salesperson_id; the Sales Order's stopped freezing it (owner 2026-08-17, reason at so-identity-lock.ts:10 — a DO or SI snapshots the customer, the addresses and the money, never WHO SOLD IT, and freezing it stranded a resigning salesperson's delivered orders where the replacement could not even SEE them, because SO row visibility keys off that very column). Whether that ruling extends to consignment orders is a business judgement and his to make, not a checker's. The other four columns in the delta (customer_po, customer_po_id, customer_po_date, po_doc_no) are SCHEMA — only consignment_orders carries them — and are not in question.

TWO ARMS OF ONE MAP, three lines apart in one declaration: AC_TRANSFER_HEADER_KEYS in autocount-convert-lines.ts. The GR arm is PurchaseHeader plus the goods receipt's own SupplierDONo; the PI arm is PurchaseHeader plus the purchase invoice's own SupplierInvoiceNo. Each line carries a comment saying exactly that. Meant to differ, and the difference is visible to anyone reading either line — the opposite of the invisible second home this gate hunts.

THE STATES A DELIVERY MAY BE INVOICED FROM — a VENDORED TWIN of one declaration, not a second decision. The rule has one home in backend/src/scm/shared/do-shipped-states.ts and a byte-identical copy under frontend/src/vendor/shared/ so the browser can gate the transfer button on the same list the server enforces. Four hand-typed spellings of this rule are what the parent PR removes; keeping the twin is the price of a browser that cannot import backend/src. Refereed since this PR by frontend/src/vendor/shared/do-shipped-states.canonical.test.ts, which byte-compares the two files. It was NOT refereed before: check-shared-mirrors classed the pair TESTED on a text heuristic satisfied by an unrelated do-next-step test, so corrupting the twin left --strict at 0 DIVERGED and exit 0.

A DIFFERENT QUESTION, and AR_STATUSES says so in its own comment: "a draft has no money story yet and a cancelled one is closed". It is the receivables population, deliberately narrower than the lifecycle vocabulary — not the same rule enforced at N-1 of N places.

The same vocabulary against the PO DETAIL page's own STAGE_LABEL. It is a display map and it is entitled to lag nothing: ON_HOLD was added to it in the same change, and the near-miss the gate reports is the moment BEFORE that. Worth keeping recorded rather than collapsed, because the detail page also carries effectiveOf, whose fall-through used to answer CANCELLED — so a HELD purchase order told the buyer it was cancelled. Fixed in the same change; this entry is where the next reader learns that this page has two maps to update, not one.

THE PURCHASE ORDER'S STATUS VOCABULARY, in its write home and its TWO display homes. VALID_STATUSES is what the PATCH accepts; status-pill's PO map is what a value reads as on a list; STAGE_LABEL is what it reads as on the detail page. Three homes, one vocabulary, and they must agree — a value the route accepts and a map cannot name renders as a raw slug, which is how ASSR printed the word "voided" on the customer portal. They became identical on 2026-08-21 when ON_HOLD (mig 0318) was added to all three. THE DIVERGENCE THAT MATTERS IS A DISPLAY MAP FALLING BEHIND THE ROUTE, and the detail page carries a THIRD thing to update alongside them: effectiveOf, whose fall-through answered CANCELLED, so a held purchase order told the buyer it was cancelled until this change named ON_HOLD there too.

TWO DIFFERENT QUESTIONS that share three words. MAIN_CATS asks which categories are MAIN PRODUCTS — a business rule about what blocks a sale from shipping, and accessories are deliberately not in it. TONE_BY_BUCKET asks which COLOUR each display group gets, and it needs a fourth member for exactly the reason the first one does not have it: everything that is NOT a main product still has to be drawn, so OTHER is the catch-all. Merging them would make a colour table decide what blocks a shipment. The extra member is the difference between a rule and a palette, and it is the whole point of both. See frontend/src/lib/brandingTone.ts and docs/modules/document-status-vocabulary.md.

THE POSITION 4-LEVEL ACCESS VOCABULARY on both sides of the wire. The backend home is POSITION_ACCESS_LEVELS (pageAccess.ts) and every stored value is validated against it; the matrix screen cannot import server code, so its click-cycle order restates the same four levels. The wire contract (PUT /api/position-capabilities/:id/pages rejects anything else) is the referee, pinned by backend/tests/positionPageOverrides.test.ts.

CLOSED means STOP CHASING THE REMAINDER (2026-08-22): the customer took 7 of the 10 or the supplier cannot supply the last 3, the delivered part stands and the document is NOT voided. Owner, asked whether that case happens here: 「有的」. It is NOT Cancel, which voids the whole document. Definition and guard: backend/src/scm/lib/so-lifecycle-guards.ts. THE WRITE VOCABULARY AND A DISPLAY MAP, momentarily equal. SO_STATUSES is the manual PATCH whitelist and the source the status TABS are generated from; SalesOrderDetail's SO_STATUS_LABEL is what a stored value READS AS on that page. They are equal today because CLOSED returned to the vocabulary and the label map had never stopped naming it — which is the correct direction for them to converge from. They are not required to stay equal: a display map must be able to name every enum label for ever, including any the vocabulary later retires, because Postgres cannot DROP VALUE and a status with no label falls through to printing its raw slug (ASSR printed the word 'voided' on the customer portal that way). The divergence that would matter is the opposite one — the display map falling BEHIND the route — and that is what this entry exists to make the next reader check.

THE SALES ORDER TAB VOCABULARY VERSUS ITS WRITE VOCABULARY, differing by SHIPPED. Two different questions, not one rule with two homes. SO_STATUSES answers 'may a row be moved to this status' and SHIPPED is still legal and still WRITTEN by so-delivery-sync when a delivery order is raised. SO_TAB_STATUSES answers 'which tab shows this row', and SHIPPED has no tab of its own because the owner folded it into Delivered on 2026-08-22 (「Sales Order 的 Shipped 跟 Delivered 是合起来的」). A status that is written but has no tab of its own is exactly what folding IS. CLOSED is on both sides: it is written again, and unlike SHIPPED it gets its own tab, because an order whose remainder was abandoned is a different fact from one delivered in full.

THE TAB BUCKETS VERSUS status-pill's SO DISPLAY MAP, differing by RETURNED and SHIPPED. The label map is entitled to be wider and must be: RETURNED is a lifecycle word soStatusDisplay computes and no column ever stores, and SHIPPED is a stored status the owner folded into the Delivered tab — both still have to render a WORD rather than a raw enum key. The buckets list only what has a tab TODAY. Having a tab and having a label are different questions, and the asymmetry is what keeps a folded or retired row readable.

THE SALES ORDER TAB BUCKETS VERSUS THE CONSIGNMENT ORDER'S OWN LABEL MAP, differing by DRAFT and SHIPPED. Two different documents and two different questions. The consignment order has no DRAFT — one is never saved as a draft — and its label map still names SHIPPED because it is a label map, while the Sales Order's SHIPPED has no tab since the fold into Delivered. Neither difference is one rule applied at N-1 of N places.

THE SALES ORDER DOWNSTREAM THRESHOLD VERSUS THE GRN'S LABEL MAP. Four of the five words coincide and that is all they share: one is a deny-list of sales-order statuses no delivery order or purchase order may be built from, the other is the set of GRN statuses status-pill can name. Different document, different question, and POSTED is not a sales-order status at all. A collision of vocabulary, not of rules.

THE DOWNSTREAM THRESHOLD VERSUS 'IS THIS ORDER FINISHED', differing by DRAFT. so-status.ts TERMINAL and the ConsignmentOrders row test ask whether an order still has anything happening; a DRAFT does, so it is correctly absent from them. The deny-list asks whether a document may be BUILT from the order, and a draft may not, because it is not committed yet. The same word means 'nothing left to do' in one and 'not started' in the other, which is exactly why the two sets must not be merged.

CLOSED means STOP CHASING THE REMAINDER (2026-08-22): the customer took 7 of the 10 or the supplier cannot supply the last 3, the delivered part stands and the document is NOT voided. Owner, asked whether that case happens here: 「有的」. It is NOT Cancel, which voids the whole document. Definition and guard: backend/src/scm/lib/so-lifecycle-guards.ts. THE DOWNSTREAM THRESHOLD VERSUS THE COMMISSION EXCLUSION, differing by CLOSED, and the difference is the whole point of the status. Nothing more may be SHIPPED OR BOUGHT for a closed order, so it is in the deny-list. But the part that DID go out was really sold, so the salesperson keeps the commission on it — which is why CLOSED is deliberately NOT in COMMISSION_EXCLUDED_STATUSES. Adding it there would take pay off a salesperson because the customer shortened his own order. hr-commission.ts asks for exactly this consideration in its own comment ('a new status must be considered here deliberately'), and this entry is the record that it was.

THE SO SOURCE THRESHOLD — which sales order a downstream document may be built from. ONE question, two spellings plus a vendored twin, PINNED rather than collapsed. The DELIVERY arm moved out of routes/delivery-orders-mfg.ts into shared/so-deliverable-states.ts on 2026-08-21 because it had ALSO been hand-written in the SO list as an allow-list of ONE value ('confirmed'), so the Transfer button vanished on READY_TO_SHIP — a status the stock allocator writes by itself the moment the goods land. The frontend copy is a byte-identical VENDORED TWIN refereed by frontend/src/vendor/shared/so-deliverable-states.canonical.test.ts, not a second decision. SO_UNORDERABLE_STATUSES (refuses a PO) asks the same question as soCanRaiseDo (refuses a DO) and the two are held EQUAL by backend/tests/duplicatedDecisionPins.test.ts PIN 2: a threshold one write path enforces and the other does not means a document type can be built from an order the other refuses. MOVED AGAIN 2026-08-22 — SO_UNORDERABLE_STATUSES left routes/mfg-purchase-orders.ts for lib/source-document-gates.ts, which now holds all three source-document gates side by side (SO->DO, SO->PO, PO->GRN). The reason was mig 0324, which turned the HOLD into a marker column beside the status: all three gates could previously see a hold FOR FREE because it lived in the `status` column they already read, and two of them said so in their own migration headers. Moving them together makes the next hold-shaped question one edit instead of three. CLOSED JOINED ALL THREE ON 2026-08-22, and one reason covers all of them: close means STOP CHASING THE REMAINDER — the customer took 7 of the 10, or the supplier cannot supply the last 3, and the delivered part STANDS while the document is NOT voided (owner, asked whether that case happens here: 「有的」). If the remainder is not coming, nothing more ships against the order and nothing more is bought for it. CLOSED is NOT CANCELLED, which voids the whole document; definition and guard in backend/src/scm/lib/so-lifecycle-guards.ts. COMMISSION_EXCLUDED_STATUSES used to be a fourth home of this same membership and no longer is, because CLOSED is deliberately absent from it — the part that went out was really sold. That near-miss is recorded separately in this file. See docs/bugs/0504-transfer-to-delivery-order-vanished-the-moment-stock-arrived.md, docs/bugs/0516-putting-an-order-on-hold-destroyed-its-progress-and-taking-i.md and docs/bugs/0517-a-short-shipped-sales-order-had-nowhere-to-stop-only-a-cance.md

THE DO SHIPPED STATES against the CONSIGNMENT NOTE's rendered status flow, differing by CANCELLED. One is the stock-out write trigger, the other is the ladder a detail screen draws; a cancelled note is a rung you can see and never a state whose entry deducts stock. Consignment is owned separately and is deliberately NOT changed here — see the delivery-order module guide's follow-up note. Pair appeared 2026-08-22 when LOADED joined the shipped set and the two lists came within one member of each other.

TWO QUESTIONS ABOUT ONE LADDER, both declared in do-shipped-states.ts and differing by exactly INVOICED: DO_SHIPPED_STATES asks whether the stock has left, SI_TRANSFERABLE_DO_STATES asks whether a Sales Invoice may be raised. That file's own header states at length why folding them would be the expensive kind of tidy — dropping INVOICED from the shipped set would tell the ledger an INVOICED delivery's stock never left. Pair appeared 2026-08-22 when LOADED joined the shipped set.

THE WHOLE VOCABULARY against the STOCK-MOVING SUBSET of it, differing by DRAFT and CANCELLED. DO_STATUSES is every legal scm.do_status label and is BUILT from DO_SHIPPED_STATES in the same file, so these cannot drift: one is literally derived from the other. Pair appeared 2026-08-22 when LOADED joined the shipped set.

A RENDERED STATUS MAP against the stock-out write trigger, differing by CANCELLED and RETURNED. A pill map covers every status a row can arrive in, including two the deduction never fires on; it is how a status is displayed, not a second answer to which ones move stock. Same reasoning as the sibling rendering entries above. Pair appeared 2026-08-22 when LOADED joined the shipped set.

THE REVERT'S BACKWARD LIFECYCLE RANK against the mobile detail's FORWARD next-status map. RANK (routes/delivery-order-revert.ts) orders DRAFT<LOADED<DISPATCHED for ONE purpose — proving a revert target is strictly EARLIER than the current status — while MobileModuleDetail.tsx's `next` maps each status to the one AHEAD of it, with '' as the terminal sentinel (no next) the backward rank has no use for. Opposite directions of the same lifecycle, and NOT one rule at N-1 of N places: folding them would make the revert's backward check depend on the forward step map, but the two move independently — the owner adds forward steps as their machines land, while the revertable set is fixed at the two dock-mistake states (LOADED / DISPATCHED). Differs by '' precisely because a backward rank has no terminal.

THE SETTLEMENT BUCKET SET under its one home, the MatchBucket union (acc/settlement-match): the backend line initialises a tally over it and the frontend line maps it to display labels, a client-side map that cannot round-trip. Both sites are Record-typed against that union, so adding a bucket fails compilation at both rather than diverging silently.

THE MIRROR ITSELF, not a second decision. backend/src/scm/shared/ is the original and frontend/src/vendor/shared/ is its byte-identical copy; check-shared-mirrors.mjs --strict FAILS THE BUILD when they differ, which is the opposite of the drift this check exists to catch. SOFA_HANDS is declared ONCE per side and the rank map and the group walk both read it — the earlier version did have two statements of the order in one file (a Record plus a literal array) and this check caught it correctly; that is fixed. Cost of divergence here is a build failure, not a wrong sofa.

THE MIRROR ITSELF, not a second decision. PLACEHOLDER_BRAND_TEXTS is declared ONCE in scm/shared/ and frontend/src/vendor/shared/ is its byte-identical copy, which check-shared-mirrors.mjs --strict fails the build over if the two ever differ - the opposite of the drift this check exists to catch.
